resources.string: A private messenger. Your identity comes from your secret phrase, and your chats are encrypted on your device.
The key lives on your devices
People message you and send Montana to it
Your phone carries the messages itself
Enter the 24 words separated by spaces, in the correct order.
Invalid phrase. Check the words and their order.
The identity could not be stored on this device
Store it securely: a password manager you trust, or write it down on paper and keep it offline. Don\'t take a screenshot or store it in Notes.
I\'ve saved the words in a safe place
Nothing was created. Unlock the device and try again — an identity that is not stored cannot be opened at the next launch.
Everything here stays on your device. Nothing is published: your correspondent sees only what you choose to show. Leave the name empty and your call sign is used.
Montana is a messenger between people who chose to talk to each other. Every conversation is encrypted end to end; nobody but its two sides can read it.
By using Montana you agree to these terms.
There is no tolerance for objectionable content or abusive users: threats, harassment, hate speech, sexual content involving minors, spam and any content that breaks the law.
You must be 18 or older to use Montana.
A person who sends such content or abuses others is barred from Montana\'s relays and doors.
Block: a blocked person can no longer reach you — their letters are refused on every road and never shown.
Report: any letter or person can be reported from its menu. Reports are reviewed within 24 hours; offending content is removed and the offender is barred.
Filter: letters carrying objectionable words are folded by default and unfold only by your tap. The filter is yours to keep or turn off in Privacy.
Delete: any letter can be removed from your feed at once — for you, or for everyone.

The key to your identity is your 24-word seed phrase, which you're about to see. Recovery is only possible with it.

Lose it and you lose access to your identity and chats forever. Don't show it to anyone.

Store it securely — using whatever method of storing confidential data you trust (for example, a password manager), or write it down by hand on paper and keep it offline. Don't take a screenshot or save it in Notes.
By continuing, you agree to the [Terms of Use](montana://terms) and [Privacy Policy](montana://privacy).
Signing in with %1$s is coming to Montana for Android in a later version.
